name: Skill Authoring Workshop
description: Workflow for turning successful Lilly tool chains into compact registered skills with triggers, chain steps, tests, and proof loops.
triggerPatterns: turn this workflow into a skill

chain.step: Search existing skills first and decide whether to update, create, or leave as one-off guidance.
Extract a reusable trigger, operating model, lane/tool chain, boundaries, proof loop, and failure handling.
Create or update one compact skill with exact tool ids and trigger phrases.
Use skill-context with sample prompts to prove the selector finds the intended skill.
Run focused tests when skill-store, route behavior, or metadata propagation changes.
